    98→-- All original authored coordinates are expressed in design units.
    99→-- Human scale, NOT a giant doll: building, machines and controls together

   102→local WORLD_SCALE=0.50
   103→local UNITS=Vector3
   104→local FRAME=CFrame
   105→local Vector3={
   106→	new=function(x,y,z)
   107→		return UNITS.new((x or 0)*WORLD_SCALE,
   108→			(y or 0)*WORLD_SCALE,(z or 0)*WORLD_SCALE)
   109→	end,
   110→	zero=UNITS.zero,
   111→}
   112→local CFrame={
   113→	new=function(x,y,z)
   114→		if type(x)=="number" or x==nil then
   115→			return FRAME.new((x or 0)*WORLD_SCALE,
   116→				(y or 0)*WORLD_SCALE,(z or 0)*WORLD_SCALE)
   117→		end
   118→		-- A Vector3 passed here ALREADY represents world-space studs.
   119→		return FRAME.new(x)
   120→	end,
   121→	lookAt=FRAME.lookAt,
   122→	Angles=FRAME.Angles,
   123→}

   194→local function part(parent,name,cf,size,color,material,alpha,collide,shape)
   195→	local p=Instance.new("Part")
   196→	p.Name=name;p.CFrame=cf;p.Size=size
   197→	p.Color=color or C.silver;p.Material=material or Enum.Material.Metal
   198→	p.Transparency=alpha or 0;p.Anchored=true
   199→	p.CanCollide=collide==true;p.CanTouch=collide==true
   200→	p.CastShadow=(p.Material~=Enum.Material.Neon)
   201→	p.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
   202→	p.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
   203→	if shape then p.Shape=shape end
   204→	p.Parent=parent
   205→	return p
   206→end
   207→local function box(parent,name,pos,size,color,mat,alpha,collide)
   208→	return part(parent,name,CFrame.new(pos),size,color,mat,alpha,collide)
   209→end
   210→local function ball(parent,name,pos,r,color,mat,alpha,collide)
   211→	return part(parent,name,CFrame.new(pos),Vector3.new(2*r,2*r,2*r),
   212→		color,mat,alpha,collide,Enum.PartType.Ball)
   213→end
   214→local function beam(parent,name,a,b,width,color,mat,alpha,collide)
   215→	local length=(b-a).Magnitude
   216→	if length<0.01 then return nil end
   217→	return part(parent,name,CFrame.lookAt((a+b)/2,b),
   218→		UNITS.new(width*WORLD_SCALE,width*WORLD_SCALE,length),
   219→		color,mat,alpha,collide)
   220→end
   221→local function tube(parent,name,a,b,r,color,mat,alpha,collide)
   222→	local length=(b-a).Magnitude
   223→	if length<0.01 then return nil end
   224→	return part(parent,name,CFrame.lookAt((a+b)/2,b)*
   225→		CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0),
   226→		UNITS.new(length,2*r*WORLD_SCALE,2*r*WORLD_SCALE),
   227→		color,mat,alpha,collide,Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
   228→end
   229→local function cylY(parent,name,center,r,height,color,mat,alpha,collide)
   230→	return part(parent,name,CFrame.new(center)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2),
   231→		Vector3.new(height,2*r,2*r),color,mat,alpha,collide,
   232→		Enum.PartType.Cylinder)

   234→local function circleXY(parent,name,center,r,n,width,color,mat,alpha)
   235→	local pieces={}
   236→	for i=0,n-1 do
   237→		local a=i*TAU/n;local b=(i+1)*TAU/n
   238→		local p=center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*r,math.sin(a)*r,0)
   239→		local q=center+Vector3.new(math.cos(b)*r,math.sin(b)*r,0)
   240→		pieces[#pieces+1]=beam(parent,name.."_"..i,p,q,width,color,mat,alpha)
   241→	end
   242→	return pieces
   243→end
   244→local function circleXZ(parent,name,center,r,n,width,color,mat,alpha)
   245→	local pieces={}
   246→	for i=0,n-1 do
   247→		local a=i*TAU/n;local b=(i+1)*TAU/n
   248→		local p=center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*r,0,math.sin(a)*r)
   249→		local q=center+Vector3.new(math.cos(b)*r,0,math.sin(b)*r)
   250→		pieces[#pieces+1]=beam(parent,name.."_"..i,p,q,width,color,mat,alpha)
   251→	end
   252→	return pieces
   253→end
   254→local function lamp(parent,color,power,range)

   339→local function fracture(from,to,n,tint,parent)
   340→	local last=from
   341→	for i=1,n do
   342→		local p=from:Lerp(to,i/n)
   343→		if i<n then p=p+Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-2.6,2.6),
   344→			rng:NextNumber(-2.6,2.6),rng:NextNumber(-2.6,2.6)) end
   345→		local seg=beam(parent or transient,"ERRATIC_DISCHARGE",last,p,
   346→			rng:NextNumber(0.16,0.48),tint or C.cyan,
   347→			Enum.Material.Neon,0.04)
   348→		if parent==nil and seg then Debris:AddItem(seg,0.32) end
   349→		last=p
   350→	end
   351→end
   352→local function throwShard(ref,color,scale,velocity,life)

   357→		wasNeon and C.trim or color or ref.Color,

   359→		0.03,true,ref.Shape)

   374→local function centerPulse(radius,duration,color)
   375→	-- The V1 pulse grew to a 187-STUD white sphere; it physically crossed
   376→	-- the 93-stud observation plane and overexposed the entire control room.
   377→	-- The cinematic belongs BEHIND the glass. World-space diameter <= 52.
   378→	local safeDiameter=math.min(52,math.max(8,radius*4.6))
   379→	local spark=ball(transient,"CHAMBER_ONLY_PLASMA_SURGE",
   380→		CORE+Vector3.new(0,0,23),
   381→		math.min(1.7,radius*0.35),color or C.magenta,
   382→		Enum.Material.Neon,0.66)
   383→	spark.CastShadow=false
   384→	local shower=particles(spark,"RADIAL_WHITE_HOT_DISCHARGE",
   385→		SPARK,0,color or C.ivory,0.62,0.045,32)
   386→	shower.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180)
   387→	shower.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.32,0.78)
   388→	shower:Emit(math.floor(16+radius*4))
   389→	tween(spark,duration,{Size=Vector3.new(safeDiameter,safeDiameter,
   390→		safeDiameter),Transparency=1},Enum.EasingStyle.Quart)
   391→	Debris:AddItem(spark,duration+0.25)
   392→end
   393→local function outwardFrontWave(first,last,seconds,color)
   394→	local wave={}
   395→	for i=0,35 do
   396→		local a=i*TAU/36;local b=(i+1)*TAU/36
   397→		wave[#wave+1]=beam(transient,"WINDOW_FACING_SHOCK_RING",
   398→			CORE+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*first,math.sin(a)*first,29),
   399→			CORE+Vector3.new(math.cos(b)*first,math.sin(b)*first,29),
   400→			1.05,color or C.violet,Enum.Material.Neon,0.48)
   401→	end
   402→	task.spawn(function()
   403→		local started=now()
   404→		while now()-started<seconds do
   405→			local u=math.clamp((now()-started)/seconds,0,1)
   406→			local r=first+(last-first)*u
   407→			for i,p in ipairs(wave) do
   408→				local a=(i-1)*TAU/36;local b=i*TAU/36
   409→				local x=CORE+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*r,math.sin(a)*r,29)
   410→				local y=CORE+Vector3.new(math.cos(b)*r,math.sin(b)*r,29)
   411→				p.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((x+y)/2,y)
   412→				p.Size=UNITS.new(1.05*WORLD_SCALE,1.05*WORLD_SCALE,
   413→					(y-x).Magnitude)
   414→				p.Transparency=0.48+0.51*u
   415→			end
